podcast.title: Reflections on Godspell (2021)
podcast.body: In May 2021, on the 50th anniversary of *Godspell*'s debut, Robin Lamont, who was in the original cast and the movie, described her involvement as "in many ways an act of love," despite not being a very religious person. "although I'm not a very religious person, it was in many ways an act of love."
